name: inite-brain
description: Persistent, bitemporal memory for Claude Code: the MCP tool surface, six skills that teach the model to use it, recall injected at session start, and capture before compaction.

api_key.title: Brain API key
api_key.description: Issue one at https://brain.inite.ai/en/app/keys — it starts with brain_ and is shown once.

base_url.title: Brain base URL
base_url.description: Change only for a self-hosted deployment.

user_id.title: Personal memory scope (optional)
user_id.description: Tags what the hooks write and read with this end-user id, so a shared workspace key still keeps your memory yours. Leave empty to use the workspace-wide scope.

recall_on_start.title: Recall at session start
recall_on_start.description: Inject what brain already knows about this project into the first turn.

capture_sessions.title: Capture sessions into memory
capture_sessions.description: Send what you asked for (your messages, never the model's own output) to brain before compaction and at session end, so the next session starts informed.
